parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Real use: **Email Trigger (IMAP)** reads unread emails sent to the intake address (`samisiam851+costs@gmail.com`).
Demo/tests: **Test Intake Webhook** accepts the same email as JSON (`npm run scenarios`).

Reference data (projects, suppliers, staff, POs) is loaded once per run.

## 2. One document at a time
Each attachment (or the email body) is processed in its own loop iteration, so two documents for the same supplier/month can never race each other on the summary.

## 3. Extract (rules) + match
PDF text -> invoice no., date, due date / terms, amount, currency, paid status.
Supplier: sender email -> domain -> name in document. Project: code (RIV-001) -> PO number -> name -> site address -> keyword.

## 🤖 AI extraction slot
Placeholder by design. To add an LLM later: replace this node with an AI/HTTP call that runs only when `$json.parsed` is missing fields, and merge its answer into `parsed`. Everything downstream stays the same.

## 4. Duplicates & updates
Dedupe Key = supplier + invoice no.
- not found -> **create**
- same data -> **duplicate** (count +1, nothing else)
- changed -> **update** (status only moves forward; amount change is flagged)

## 5. Supporting document
PDF/photo uploaded to Notion with the File Upload API (free plan: 5 MB) and attached to the cost record.

## 6. Supplier Monthly Summary
Totals are **recomputed from the cost records** for the affected supplier + month + currency (never incremented), so re-runs cannot double-count.

## 7. Notify
Recorded -> project manager. Needs review -> office admin + Kevin.
Demo mode: everything goes to `samisiam851@gmail.com` with a "This is a demo" banner naming the real recipients.
